facts.fact: Augentic signed a 15-year Build-Operate-Transfer contract with the DGSN on 13 May 2024 to produce and operate the new biometric national ID card system, with equipment and infrastructure to be handed over to the Cameroonian government once the 'Operate' component ends, according to Biometric Update.
facts.system: new generation biometric national ID card

systems.system: new generation biometric national ID card
